The powerful forces trying to dominate our country want us to fall into cynicism.

That way, they win everything — and they'll be able to take it all without the rest of us putting up a fight.

If you are worried about the future, you are not alone. I am too.

But please do not fall into cynicism.

Earlier this year, Meta began laying off 8,000 workers as it ramps up AI investment.

The irony of a Big Tech King buying a castle is not lost on me.

Food companies wanted deregulation. Now there are dozens of recalls across the country.

Mining companies wanted deregulation. Now the black lung rate is at a 45-year high.

Financial companies wanted deregulation. Now financial losses to fraud are the highest on record.

Noticing a pattern?

posts.text:
U.S. workers are already spending nearly $400 more on healthcare costs in 2026. Next year, they’ll face the sharpest rise in healthcare costs in nearly 20 years.

Meanwhile, Medicare for All is supported by 65% of voters — including 71% of independents and 49% of Republicans.

Is it any wonder why?
